crossRefs.note: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her…
But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash…
The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.
We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the…
Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia…

translations.web: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
translations.bsb: And if the woman is unwilling to follow you, then you are released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”
translations.kjv: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
translations.asv: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath. Only thou shalt not bring my son thither again.
